big_case.notes: Independent read: a single small tribe's Indian Tucker Act damages claim over a third party's upstream water diversion, decided below on Arizona v. Navajo Nation's source-of-law threshold, with two further CFC jurisdictional grounds (28 U.S.C. 1500 and 2501) unreached on appeal. No circuit split alleged, no amici, small-firm petition, and the Court denied without a noted dissent. Tribal trust-duty doctrine is a live area, which keeps this above the floor, but nothing beyond the parties rode on this vehicle. The staged prediction.json files carry each candidate's big_case_score, and I had already dumped those files before forming this read, so its independence from the candidates' scores is imperfect; the read above was formed from the record and the outcome, and I did not adjust it toward any candidate's figure.
